## Changes made from the upstream version

Modified by SkillOffice on 2026-11-13:

- Kept the four-part framework (map current state, identify waste, design future state, measure impact) and the waste categories, rewritten in our own words.
- Added finding the bottleneck first, root-cause analysis that targets design rather than people, arithmetic and assumptions for every estimated benefit, and a baseline and target for the main metric.
- Replaced "automate where possible" with automating only stable, repeatable work, and added a rule never to remove financial, access or data controls without a named approver.
- Added an implementation plan with quick wins, pilot and rollback, safety rules and a handoff section.
